content_blocks.label: clause_1._Scope_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: The Disclosing Party may disclose to the Receiving Party certain confidential information as defined in Exhibit A attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Use_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party agrees that it shall use the Confidential Information solely for the purpose of evaluating the potential business relationship between the Parties and shall not disclose such information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Duration_of_Obligation
content_blocks.text: The obligations of the Receiving Party under this Agreement shall survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement for a period of three (3) years.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 27th day of September 2024.
